State change: `pm:queue` removed in this stroke. Under the multi-replica declaration (`declaresReplicasSharingState`), `os serve` now refuses with exit 1 before `runtime.start` when the primary datasource is SQLite, sqlite-wasm, or a libSQL `file:` URL (the no-URL default included). The refusal names Postgres `OS_DATABASE_URL` and never echoes the URL. Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB and remote libSQL servers (`libsql://`, `wss://`, `http(s)://`) are not refused. Undeclared boots are unchanged. Known limit, seat-ruled: a host config whose own plugin registers the driver is not judged before boot. Docs: `cluster.mdx` and `self-hosting.mdx`. #31930 (`service.instance.id`, p2), which was serial after this card on `serve.ts`, stays unopened under the p1-only order.
